note: Deterministic contract suite for the v0.3.0-alpha.1 work system. Passing it is E1 evidence — the resources declare and satisfy their contracts. It says nothing about runtime effectiveness, which remains not measured for every resource.

v0.3-skill.note: Authored or rewritten for v0.3. Each must satisfy the full skill contract.

carried-over-skill.note: Carried into the v0.3 plugin byte-identical from v0.2. Their existing E1 evidence remains true because nothing about them changed; they are re-verified here against the same assertions the v0.2 suite used. They will be brought to the full v0.3 skill contract in a later release, which will require them to re-earn E1.

v0.3-agent.note: Agents are resources and are tested as such: routing, non-trigger, skill reference, tool policy, no duplicated procedure, no hidden upstream dependency.

discovery.note: Proves the discoverability contract mechanically: a learning captured in one context must surface for a different, later context, superseded documents must not surface, and weak matches must be dropped rather than padded.
